heroHeadline: PDF and AA Dismantle Junta Militias Across Magway; Myitche Massacre Revealed as 500 SAC Troops Kill Dozens in Sagaing — Day 1,952
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,952 (June 7, 2026), Myanmar's multi-front civil war continues with significant resistance operations: the Anyar Land Coalition (PDF) captured ~70 Pyu Saw Htee militia members in Pauk Township (Magway) and the Arakan Army claimed to have killed or captured 500+ junta troops intercepting a 1,000-man SAC column in Mindon Township — demonstrating the AA's expanding reach beyond Rakhine State into Magway supply corridors. In Sagaing Region, residents returned to Myitche Town on June 6 to discover dozens of civilian bodies after a month-long 500-troop SAC operation burned homes, destroyed monasteries, and killed residents attempting to extinguish fires — the latest mass atrocity in Myanmar's PDF heartland following the June 3 Kanbalu double airstrike (133+ killed). Resistance forces fired four 107mm rockets at Toungoo Air Base (Kaytumadi) on June 6, reportedly timed to a secret visit by Min Aung Hlaing. Diplomatically: Myanmar FM Tin Maung Swe completed a three-day Beijing visit (June 4–6), meeting Wang Yi who pledged to advance the China-Myanmar Economic Corridor — directly linked to the AA's advance within 5 km of China's $7.3B Kyaukphyu port. The junta rebuked Timor-Leste President Ramos-Horta for calling Myanmar 'a stain on ASEAN'; Min Aung Hlaing will skip the ASEAN-Russia Summit in Kazan (June 17–19). The Battle of Bhamo continues at stalemate: the KIA holds all captured positions (including the seized tank battalion and airport camps) while the SAC conducts up to 50 airstrikes daily. IDPs remain at approximately 5.2 million; 16.2 million require humanitarian assistance.
